title: Zucchimole
ingredients: 400g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
finely grated zest and juice of 1 unwaxed lime
large handful of coriander leaves and stalks
steps: Put all ingredients into a food processor; blend until smooth.
notes: For a more textured dip: mash beans, finely chop remaining ingredients and mix by hand. Also add finely chopped tomatoes to mix it up. Great with Weekend Veggie Chilli, Smoky Mexican Black Bean Sweet Potato Stew and Flaming Fajita Traybake.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
